race.comment: ZIGGY STARCRAFT (8) is hard to look past after a strong-closing third here first-up. He is on the quick back-up, drops into a BM55 and has already shown enough at 1200m to give this a serious shake. TARONG (6) comes off a Bowen BM50 win and has the benefit of the claiming apprentice, though this is harder company than the picnic grade he beat last time. WISER (1) brings upside from a Corowa Mdn win where he scored with a bit in hand, and his repeated 1200m placings say the trip is suitable despite coming back from 1400m. SHE'S A BEAUTY (5) is a reliable place chance with a strong Ryan Wiggins association and recent third at this venue, but the wide draw means she has to do things cleanly. LET'S RIDE (10) caught the eye when resuming here three weeks ago, flashing home from last to get within a length of the winner. Is draw to settle much closer this time and is among the winning chances.
